title: Meet Deborah and Regina: More Than a Ride to the Doctor
summary: Transportation visits between Papa member Deborah and her Papa Pal, Regina, provide both practical help and life-giving encouragement.
body_markdown: Regina sees caring for older adults as both a calling and a way to give back. “My purpose has been to be a caretaker,” she says. “That’s just what I do.” She reminds us that our parents and grandparents cared for us, and now it’s our turn. Whether it’s offering a listening ear, a ride to the grocery store, company at the doctor’s office, or simply someone to play a game with, Regina meets her members where they are—and makes sure they never feel like a burden. “It’s a privilege and a joy to take care of them,” she says.
